warnings: No external zone file found; using the exact no-fly-zons/no_fly_zones.json snapshot embedded at build time. Rebuild or set PLANNER_NO_FLY_ZONES to update.
No external restriction_zones.json found; using the exact snapshot embedded at build time. Rebuild or set PLANNER_RESTRICTION_ZONES to update.
MVP model: flat terrain, constant cruise speed, 50% side/forward overlap; no wind, terrain or autopilot dynamics. WGS84 local metric approximation is limited to a 50 km envelope (+/-65 latitude).

Exclusions include convex hulls of polygon zones and holes, buffered by configured clearance; circles are conservatively enlarged. Coverage is planned only outside these enlarged exclusions; full coverage of the originally requested area is not claimed.

battery_usage is distance/max_flight_distance (%), not an electrochemical battery prediction. Range/home limits use 2% model margin. No per-UAV endurance is supplied by the API; only range and operation window apply unless PLANNER_MAX_FLIGHT_TIME_SECONDS is set.
Separation uses time-parameterized 3D route segments; delays and tracking errors are not modeled. Turnaround is 300.000000 seconds, separation is 30.000000 m, exclusion clearance is 20.000000 m.
Repeated uav_id entries represent separate sorties. Existing frontend Mission Planner ZIP export overwrites same-UAV filenames; use the JSON response as the authoritative sortie schedule.
